name: Lizardmen
source: Town Cryer #11 (Grade 1b), Lustria setting. Text supplied directly by the owner on 2026-08-02; cross-check against your own copy. Racial maximums are not given in the source and are left unverified. Sacred Markings are one-per-Hero upgrades bought only at recruitment and are listed as exclusive equipment.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.description: Any Lizardmen within 6" of the Skink Priest may use his Leadership characteristic for Leadership tests. If the Priest is killed you may recruit a new one, but must play at least one game without a leader to give him time to join up.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.description: The Skink Priest is a Wizard and may use Lizardmen magic.

specialRules.name: Scaly Skin
specialRules.description: Skinks have a natural 6+ armour save. It cannot be modified beyond 6 by Strength modifiers, but a 'no save' result on the injury chart negates it. Light armour adds +1, as does a shield.

specialRules.name: Aquatic
specialRules.description: Skinks may move through water terrain with no penalty, and count as being in cover while in the water.

specialRules.name: Jungle born
specialRules.description: All Skinks can move through jungle terrain without penalty.

specialRules.name: Cold Blooded
specialRules.description: Roll 3D6 and select the lowest two dice when taking a psychology test or Rout test.

heroSlots.notes: The profile is listed as A 1+1 in the source: one Attack plus the Bite attack.

specialRules.name: Scaly Skin
specialRules.description: Saurus have a natural 5+ armour save. It cannot be modified beyond 6 by Strength modifiers, but a 'no save' result on the injury chart negates it. Light armour adds +1, as does a shield.

specialRules.name: Bite Attack
specialRules.description: An extra attack using the Saurus' own Strength to wound, with no penalty for being unarmed. The bite always strikes last, regardless of who charged or which weapon is used.

specialRules.name: Cold Blooded
specialRules.description: Roll 3D6 and select the lowest two dice when taking a psychology test or Rout test. A Lizardmen warband may never use the Leadership of a Saurus or Kroxigor for a Rout test.

specialRules.name: No missile weapons
specialRules.description: Saurus can never use missile weapons and can never receive Academic skills.

specialRules.name: Scaly Skin
specialRules.description: The Kroxigor has a natural save of 4+.

specialRules.name: Aquatic
specialRules.description: May move through water with no penalty, and counts as being in cover while in water.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.description: Kroxigor are large and frightening monsters that cause fear.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.description: A Kroxigor stands out among the rest of the warband and may be picked out by an archer even if he is not the closest model.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.description: Kroxigor are slow-witted creatures that never learn from their mistakes. The Kroxigor does not gain experience.

specialRules.description: Roll 3D6 and select the lowest two dice when taking a psychology test or Rout test. The warband may never use a Kroxigor's Leadership for a Rout test.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Stone Axe
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Counts as a club in every respect.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Bone Helmet
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Counts as a helmet in every respect.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Light armour (Lizardmen)
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Lizardmen — armour is rare among them
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Counts as light armour. Armour is rare amongst the Lizardmen and always costs 50 gc, even when bought from the standard equipment chart.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Blowpipe
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: TODO: verify vs Town Cryer #11 — the Skink equipment list gives a cost of 25 gc, but the weapon's own profile and special rules were not part of the supplied text.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Bolas
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: 16"; Strength: special. Usable once per battle and automatically recovered afterwards.

Dangerous: if the roll to hit is a natural 1, the bolas brain the wielder for a Strength 3 hit.

Entangle: a model hit is not hurt, but his legs are entangled and he cannot move. He also suffers -2 Weapon Skill in hand-to-hand combat, though he may still shoot normally. He may try to free himself in the recovery phase, and is freed on a 4+.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Javelins
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: 8"; Strength: as user.

Thrown weapon: the warrior suffers no penalty for range or for moving.

Note: the Skink list prices these at 10 gc, where the Amazon lists give 5 gc.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sacred Marking: Oversized Jaws
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Saurus Heroes only — one Sacred Marking per Hero, bought at recruitment
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: The Hero may make his bite attack with +1 Strength.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sacred Marking: Poison Glands
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Skink Heroes only — one Sacred Marking per Hero, bought at recruitment
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: He may choose to make any number of attacks with his teeth instead of his weapons; these are treated as a Saurus bite attack. They carry a +1 save modifier regardless of the Skink's Strength, and add +1 to the roll on the Injury table.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sacred Marking: Mark of the Old Ones
exclusiveEquipment.restriction: Lizardmen Heroes only — one Sacred Marking per Hero, bought at recruitment
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: The Hero may change one of his failed dice rolls into a successful one. Usable once per battle and only on actions the Hero makes himself. It may be used on a failed Rout test.

specialRules: Lizardmen (Town Cryer #11). Scaly Skin: Saurus have a 5+ save, Skinks a 6+. The save cannot be modified beyond 6 by Strength modifiers, but a 'no save' result on the injury chart negates it. Light armour adds +1, as does a shield. | Armour: armour is rare amongst the Lizardmen and light armour always costs 50 gc, even from the standard equipment chart. | Bite Attack: Saurus have a bite that uses their own Strength to wound with no penalty for being unarmed, and always strikes last. | Cold Blooded: all Lizardmen roll 3D6 and select the lowest two when taking a psychology or Rout test. A warband may never use the Leadership of a Saurus or Kroxigor for a Rout test. | Aquatic: Skinks move through water with no penalty and count as being in cover there. | Jungle born: all Skinks move through jungle terrain without penalty. | Saurus Rarity: a warband may never contain more Saurus Braves than Skink Braves. | Saurus cannot receive Academic skills and can never use missile weapons. | Min warband size 3, max 20. | Poisons: Skink Heroes may buy Dark Venom at 20 gc and Black Lotus at 10 gc as common items, usable only on missile weapons; only Saurus may use them on close combat weapons, bought as normal from the trading chart.
